d: A heated exchange unfolded in the Supreme Court when a lawyer expressed his anger over the delay in hearing his case and made remarks against Chief Justice of India Surya Kant. The lawyer claimed that he had earlier raised the matter before the CJI on November 2 but received no response even after 15 days. The situation escalated, leading to the lawyer being escorted out of the courtroom. The incident has raised questions about courtroom decorum, judicial discipline and the conduct of lawyers.
